result.interpretation: Same feature path source L/U-proxy gradient norm ratios/cosines only. Sinc Hz separately grouped; do not compare raw units across paths, infer U accuracy/newTX transfer, or pick target-driven lambda.

source_falsification.metric: fixedfinal source LCE<=.5 both new controls and paired accepted U / total U>=.25 over fixed17pseudoepochs; no U truth, V/target ranking

source_config.training_recipe: historical batch_neighbor pseudo gate+EMA+cos; no satellite; allarms identical
source_config.baseline_definition: user explicitly confirmed historical pseudo gate+EMA+cos, not CE-only baseline
source_config.classifier: unchanged ResidualPhysicalHead cosine6x160scale30 normal joint training
source_config.budget_authorization: user: feature extraction, historicaloldgate+EMA+cos; Agentchooseepochs normally<=50/model; fixedscratch50 33label+17pseudo allcontrols
source_config.cost_claim: same50epochs/11100 updates andnative L128/U256 recipe; extractor parameters/actualforward time measured separately

source_neighbor_sampling.seed_policy: same one global Torch seed draw per native sampler iterator, private order generator

source_config.classifier_training: default jointly trained only; no separate head fit
source_config.hypothesis_basis: Complete frozen-source neighbor-pair diagnostic: all3 source criteria pass, RANDOM reproduced360counts, V old-gate coverage3.410to89.962% with99.9959% precision; no target design feedback
source_config.sampling_scope: Uniform random disjoint physical-neighbor pairs vs original uniform packet order; only U loader ordering, all gates/loss weights/model/EMA/input identical

config.source_sampling: PAIRS full L6300 once, native metadata fields only
config.model_mode: eval for student and ownEMA; source derivative observer, not recorded train/dropout gradients

losses.L_CE: clean true source label CE mean, smoothing .01
losses.U_CE: strong ownEMA pseudo CE mean over full original gate mask, .16 weight
losses.entropy: strong entropy mean over all source proxies, .01 weight

config.feature_boundary: Actual identity subtree176065, exclude only class W960; keep head feature norms/gain/reference
config.stop_rule: Any provenance/role/shape/nonfinite/scope/state mutation failure preserves outputs and stops remaining rows; no automatic retry

result.mode: eval; no dropout; diagnostic derivatives, not actual recorded train gradients

result.interpretation: Same feature path source L/U-proxy gradient norm ratios/cosines only. Sinc Hz separately grouped; do not compare raw units across paths, infer U accuracy/newTX transfer, or pick target-driven lambda.

source_falsification.metric: fixedfinal source LCE<=.5 both new controls and paired accepted U / total U>=.25 over fixed17pseudoepochs; no U truth, V/target ranking

source_config.training_recipe: historical batch_neighbor pseudo gate+EMA+cos; no satellite; allarms identical
source_config.baseline_definition: user explicitly confirmed historical pseudo gate+EMA+cos, not CE-only baseline
source_config.classifier: unchanged ResidualPhysicalHead cosine6x160scale30 normal joint training
source_config.budget_authorization: user: feature extraction, historicaloldgate+EMA+cos; Agentchooseepochs normally<=50/model; fixedscratch50 33label+17pseudo allcontrols
source_config.cost_claim: same50epochs/11100 updates andnative L128/U256 recipe; extractor parameters/actualforward time measured separately

source_neighbor_sampling.seed_policy: same one global Torch seed draw per native sampler iterator, private order generator

source_config.classifier_training: default jointly trained only; no separate head fit
source_config.hypothesis_basis: Complete frozen-source neighbor-pair diagnostic: all3 source criteria pass, RANDOM reproduced360counts, V old-gate coverage3.410to89.962% with99.9959% precision; no target design feedback
source_config.sampling_scope: Uniform random disjoint physical-neighbor pairs vs original uniform packet order; only U loader ordering, all gates/loss weights/model/EMA/input identical

config.source_sampling: PAIRS full L6300 once, native metadata fields only
config.model_mode: eval for student and ownEMA; source derivative observer, not recorded train/dropout gradients

losses.L_CE: clean true source label CE mean, smoothing .01
losses.U_CE: strong ownEMA pseudo CE mean over full original gate mask, .16 weight
losses.entropy: strong entropy mean over all source proxies, .01 weight

config.feature_boundary: Actual identity subtree176065, exclude only class W960; keep head feature norms/gain/reference
config.stop_rule: Any provenance/role/shape/nonfinite/scope/state mutation failure preserves outputs and stops remaining rows; no automatic retry

interpretation: Fixed source eval old6TX sensitivities only; no actual recorded train/dropout L/U gradients, gradient causal DG attribution, newTX or U accuracy. Batch IQR is not model-seed uncertainty.
